auditRecorded: Permission change recorded in the audit log.
loadFailed: The portal settings could not be loaded.

notifications.banner: Notifications sent to clients never contain internal-only content in the title or body. In-app alerts are always on. Email is optional per event.

client.accessChangesDescription: Invitation, role change or project assignment.
client.approvalRequestDescription: A client approver is asked to approve an item.
client.changeRequestUpdateDescription: Status, response or estimate changes on a request.
client.commentOrReplyDescription: Someone replies in a client-visible discussion.
client.fileSharedDescription: A file is marked Client Visible or a new version is uploaded.
client.milestoneChangeDescription: A client-visible milestone changes status or date.
client.projectUpdateDescription: Project status changes or an update is published.
client.title: Notifications to clients

team.approvalDecisionDescription: A client approves or requests changes.
team.changeRequestDescription: A client submits a request or replies to a question.
team.clientCommentDescription: A client comments in a discussion.
team.clientFileUploadDescription: A client uploads a file to a project.
team.title: Notifications to your team

alwaysTrue.nextRequest: Deactivating a user, or removing a project assignment, takes effect on their next request, not at their next sign-in.
alwaysTrue.noTeamDirectory: A client user never sees your internal team directory and can never become an admin of your workspace.
alwaysTrue.oneOrganization: A client user belongs to exactly one organization and sees only the projects assigned to them.
alwaysTrue.ownOrganizationOnly: A Client Admin can only see and manage users in their own organization, never another client's.
alwaysTrue.title: Always true

capability.comment: Comment and reply in client-visible discussions
capability.manageUsers: Manage users in their own organization (if enabled below)
capability.upload: Upload files (where the project allows it)
capability.view: View assigned projects, milestones, client-visible tasks and files

roles.matrixDescription: Three roles, no permission builder. A role applies to every project the user is assigned to.
roles.matrixError: The role permissions could not be loaded.

selfManagement.description: Let a Client Admin manage who from their own organization has portal access, instead of routing every change through your team.

invite.description: A Client Admin can invite a colleague from their own organization.
invite.label: Let Client Admins invite users

remove.description: A Client Admin can remove another user from their own organization.
remove.label: Let Client Admins remove users

selfManagement.title: Client Admin self-management

signIn.addedOnly: Only an address that you, or a Client Admin you allow, has added can receive a code. Anyone else gets nothing.
signIn.code: There are no passwords. A client signs in with a 6-digit code sent to their email address. It works once and expires after 10 minutes.
signIn.description: Nothing to configure. Every client signs in the same way.
signIn.direct: Clients can also open the portal, type their address and receive a code, without the link.
signIn.link: An invitation email carries a sign-in link with the address built in. Opening it sends the code straight away. Links expire after 7 days and can be resent from Users.
signIn.title: How clients sign in

saveFailed: The portal settings could not be saved.

clientUploads.description: Client Admins and Client Members can add files. Client Viewers never can. You can override this per project.
clientUploads.label: Allow client uploads on new portal projects

showInvoices.description: Adds an Invoices page for clients. Hidden by default.
showInvoices.label: Show Invoices in the client portal

rules.defaultInternal: Tasks, files, milestones and comments are Internal Only by default, for existing and new items.
rules.explicitShare: Nothing reaches the portal until an authorized team member marks it Client Visible.
rules.neverExposed: Internal comments, time logs, estimates, costs and dependencies are never exposed, whatever you share.
rules.noHints: A hidden item is never counted or hinted at in dashboards, lists or notifications.
rules.revertImmediate: Turning an item back to Internal Only removes it from the portal immediately and keeps its internal history.
rules.title: How sharing works

shared.description: Counted over projects that have the Client Portal turned on.
shared.title: Currently shared across portal projects

subtitle: Branding, what is shared by default, roles and notifications for your client portal.
